why: Both land on the same durable rubber-and-plastic hedgehog with profit per pound of resin, but Analysis 1 calls for an outright party-plan exit, explicitly refuses to treat new-item count as a goal, and lists the complacent culture as a brutal fact, whereas Analysis 2 only puts party plan under review and makes new-product cadence a core discipline and scorecard metric. Analysis 2 is sharper on the decline mechanism, saying up front that a single-leader pattern produces a great decade rather than lasting greatness, but that does not outweigh Analysis 1's closer match on the stop-doing decisions.
